body:
The TV is often the centerpiece of the living room, and when it comes to big screens, every detail counts.

Meet Samsung Micro RGB TV, with microscopic RGB LEDs under 100 μm creating a world of vivid, precise color. With a powerful AI engine that upgrades your favorite content and a Glare-Free, anti-fingerprint surface for a worry-free experience, it’s the ultimate blend of performance and convenience.

Check out the video to see how Samsung Micro RGB TV is transforming the viewing experience through cutting-edge light source technology and AI.
